reviews.review:
I understand I have just over 1,000 hours in this game.  I will continue to put hours into it, because this is the modern Space Marine faction game we got whether I like it or not.

However, I must make known my issue I take with this game: it just never functions as it should.  *Ever*.  If Contested Health doesn't break and inexplicably stop working at random points during a mission, my perks take their place.  If that works, then an enemy spawn effect kills me from 10 meters away.  If that doesn't happen, my medicae stim fails to heal me.  If that works, my parries are ignored completely.  And if that works, my dodges manage to simultaneously succeed *and* fail, as I get the sound and visual cue for a perfect dodge, and yet get staggered and hurt regardless(these are not including specific modifiers that do some of these things, obviously; I have experienced all of the above separately in regular missions on the hardest difficulty, where I am otherwise comfortable).

I genuinely hope the third game they are working on redeems them.  I want them to prove they can make something that works as it should, at the very least.  But if they can't, I hope it is an utter embarrassment for them in all senses of the term, as I fully believe they should not be at this wheel they have found themselves behind.

P.S. Whatever happens, do not allow these developers to forget that they broke one of the main weapon defense types - turning off its AOE damage and stagger, half of the allure of this defense type, *by accident* somehow - and didn't fix it until two patches later, all while the community made a patch for it in less than a month after it was found(the issue was literally a toggle in the game's files).

I had no history on anything Warhammer related going into this and just thought it'd be like Vermintide 2, which I liked. BOY WAS I IN FOR A TREAT.. This game is simply FANTASTIC! The movement, combat and ESPEICALLY the world building is so well thought out and implemented. Not only that but the combat is extremely challenging on harder difficulties and is pretty much like a souls-like game where you have to know your combos or else you'll get downed. 
Other great highlights include the extremely detailed armor customization and being able to adjust both your perks and weapon upgrades for exactly the type of playstyle you like. I also cannot believe how stable this game is online, from all the times that I've been playing co-op or in random match-making lobbies has the game crashed once in the 40 hours I have currently put in. 
Yeah, great game!
♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ other than the campaign not worth
